title: 2-D IFFT
text: Compute 2-D inverse fast Fourier transform (IFFT), 1 input, 1 output, {FFT implementation} sets FFT implementation; {Input is in bit-reversed order} sets the bit-reversed input, {Input is conjugate symmetric} sets the conjugate symmetric input, {Divide output by product of FFT length in each input dimension} scales output data and {Lock data type settings against change by the fixed-point tools} sets the data type override. Values come from the instance.

params.name: Divide output by product of FFT length in each input dimension
Lock data type settings against change by the fixed-point tools
